label: Q01
loop: get a secret theme (or not, as imposter) -> draw it -> view drawings -> vote out the imposter -> earn cash for cosmetics
objectives: as innocent spot the fake drawing; as imposter guess the theme and blend in
progression: cash per round buys chairs, pens, titles and animations
instructions: draw the secret theme, spot the fake drawing, trick everyone as imposter, vote out the suspect
unique: imposter social deduction played through freehand drawing
update_signals: new updates and cosmetics added regularly
thumbnails: cartoon avatars at desks drawing, 'DRAW: DOG / ???' showing the imposter twist
complexity_notes: drawing canvas, round/vote system, small lobby; simple art

label: Q02
loop: spawn on a map -> a 'what if' disaster hits -> survive it -> earn credits and XP -> next disaster
instructions: survive disasters like the moon falling or a mega tsunami
unique: hypothetical cosmic disasters (moon falls, sun disappears, ocean rolls back)
thumbnails: dramatic realistic renders of tornadoes and tsunamis over a city with a scared avatar
complexity_notes: 25 scripted disasters with destruction/physics effects across 9 maps

label: Q03
loop: customers bring broken phones -> repair them by hand step by step -> earn cash -> expand shop, hire technicians, flip trade-ins
objectives: fix phones and grow the repair shop
progression: shop expansions, technicians, tools, rare phones, weekly themed cases
instructions: unscrew back, swap battery, replace screen, remove bubbles; customize and resell
unique: tactile satisfying phone-repair steps combined with a shop tycoon
thumbnails: cracked phone becoming new phone, shop interior full of customers, 'SO SATISFYING'
complexity_notes: several bespoke repair interactions, shop building, NPC customers and workers

label: Q04
loop: start night shift at a motel -> do tasks while the maniac stalks -> survive and reach an ending (secret ending possible)
objectives: survive the night shift and find the secret ending
instructions: work the night shift alone or with up to 4 friends; find the secret ending
monetization_signals: weapon passes tied to secret ending
thumbnails: dark motel at night, silhouette figure, face peeking through a door, 'BASED OFF A TRUE STORY'
complexity_notes: single linear map, scripted encounters and endings

label: Q05
loop: check in -> board plane -> jump -> dodge meteors, jets and lightning while falling -> land perfectly for score
objectives: land precisely to top the leaderboard
instructions: pick a landing zone, board the plane, dodge hazards, land perfectly
unique: queue-and-wait plane boarding sold with skip-line products
monetization_signals: kill all / scare all troll products
thumbnails: avatar falling from space toward earth; scared avatars in plane seats with countdown timers
complexity_notes: one plane, fall course with hazards, timers

label: Q06
loop: climb a troll tower -> morph into walls to hide -> slap other players off -> reach the top / earn coins and spins
objectives: climb the tower and troll others while staying hidden
progression: coins, spins for items, permanent gear
instructions: hide in walls, troll with slap hand, become best troller
unique: chameleon camouflage blending into walls inside a slap tower
thumbnails: green avatar blended into green wall, 'MORPH' button, troll face
complexity_notes: tower obby with color morph and slap tools

label: Q07
loop: answer math problem fast -> earn blocks to build your tower -> race opponents to the top
objectives: answer faster than others to win the tower race
instructions: answer quickly to earn more blocks; customize problems in private servers
unique: educational math as a competitive race
thumbnails: avatars on pillars over lava with '2+4=?' and topic grid 'Learn all of the topics!'

label: Q08
loop: pair up -> driver steers while navigator reads map and calls turns -> reach the finish -> earn coins to unlock cars and stages
objectives: finish rally stages without wrong turns by communicating
instructions: driver controls steering/handbrake; navigator calls turns and hazards
unique: two-role driver/navigator co-op inspired by Left Left LEFT!
thumbnails: two avatars in a rally car, cockpit view with map in hand, 'YOU DRIVE. THEY GUIDE.'
complexity_notes: vehicle physics, multiple long stages, two-role sync

label: Q09
loop: hold an in-game iPad -> use its apps (video call, chat, etc.) -> socialize -> earn coins for more devices
objectives: hang out and use a realistic tablet UI
instructions: just a normal day playing on your iPad
unique: first-person simulated tablet OS as the core experience
thumbnails: hands holding iPad with lock screen and FaceTime-like call, Apple logo icon
complexity_notes: UI-heavy device apps on simple map

label: Q10
loop: harpoon fish -> time reels -> eat to get fat and sink deeper -> catch rarer sea monsters -> grow them as pets in aquarium
objectives: complete the 1,800+ fish index and grow the biggest monster
progression: depth, fat multiplier, fish index, keys and crates, evolutions
instructions: aim and fire, time reels, steal others' catches, put fish in aquarium to grow
unique: getting fat to sink deeper as the depth progression
thumbnails: giant glowing sea monsters with harpoon gun and 'CAPTURE' prompt
complexity_notes: 1,800 fish variants, underwater depth zones, aquarium growth

label: Q11
loop: place towers on air/land/sea -> defend against waves and bosses -> earn currency -> unlock towers
instructions: deploy towers and defeat enemies and bosses
thumbnails: boss and tower character art with TDX logo
complexity_notes: large tower/enemy roster, many maps and modes

label: Q12
loop: enter building -> loot items while an entity hunts -> escape in time -> sell loot -> upgrade skill tree and rebirth (or play as monster)
objectives: grab the rarest loot and escape alive, or hunt as the entity
instructions: loot, hide, escape; or be the monster
unique: loot weight tradeoff in a horror heist
thumbnails: dark found-footage frames of creature 'The Locust', 'STEAL OR DIE' logo
complexity_notes: 4 maps, 4 entity AIs, VR support, progression systems

label: Q13
loop: roll for mounts -> ride across islands -> fight beasts -> earn essences -> roll more
unique: RNG roller centered on rideable mounts
thumbnails: dragon art with '1 IN 1.000.000.000' odds text

label: Q14
loop: choose bird species -> hatch and grow up -> build nest, join flocks -> roleplay and survive
instructions: choose species, customize, hatch, grow, build nest, join flocks
thumbnails: illustrated bird characters with Halloween pumpkins and the forest map
complexity_notes: large world, many animated bird species, flight

label: Q15
loop: roll cards -> build an army of stickmen -> fight enemies and bosses -> earn rolls, potions, crates -> roll rarer cards
objectives: build the strongest army, find a VOID card
instructions: roll cards, fight, roll AFK, beat bosses with friends
unique: RNG rolls that become a massed stickman army
thumbnails: giant crowned knight with '1 IN 6 BILLION', avatar in front of an army 'YOU'
